criteria.evidence: strategy.matrix.include lists ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest with runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}.
macOS step: `brew tap entireio/tap`, `brew trust entireio/tap`, `brew install --cask entire@nightly`.

Windows step (shell: pwsh) runs `./scripts/install.ps1 -Channel nightly -InstallDir $installDir`; the replay created the ps1 (as the user asked for a 'fake ps1 install') and disclosed it is not yet hosted at entire.io, invoking it from the checkout instead of a published URL.
`actions/checkout@...` with `ref: main`, step named 'Checkout repository (main)'; main-vs-tag tradeoff explained to user.

Loop runs `mise run test:e2e --agent "$agent" "$SMOKE_TEST"` for claude-code, opencode, codex, cursor-cli, copilot-cli, factoryai-droid; gemini-cli, roger-roger, vogon, pi excluded with inline reasons, Windows subset justified by absent installers.
Single test TestMultiSessionManualCommit selected: 'Two prompts, a commit, then checkpoint verification'; runner-up TestMultiSessionSequential discussed and rejected.
Turn 0 surveyed candidates (TestInteractiveMultiStep, TestMultiSessionSequential, TestMultiSessionManualCommit) and later checked roger_roger.go against external_agent_test.go.
Turn 0: 'I'll start by exploring the existing workflows and E2E test suite'; plan references e2e.yml, nightly.yml, release.yml, e2e-isolated.yml specifics.
One job per OS; 'Run smoke test for each agent' step launches agents in parallel subshells within the job, matrix has no agent dimension.
Commit 04621566 on branch add-nightly-matrix-e2e-test; told user 'no git remote configured... no gh CLI' so PR could not be opened, with commands to finish.

judge.reason: The replay delivers a nightly-scheduled OS-matrix workflow installing the nightly CLI via brew/curl/PowerShell, checking out main, and looping mise test:e2e over all installable built-in agents within each OS job using one surveyed smoke test, then committed on a branch and explained the PR could not be opened without a remote. The main doubt is n2: the PowerShell script is invoked from the checkout rather than as a published URL, though this matches the user's request to create the ps1 and was disclosed.
